entities.title: The third-person camera shows what the original hid
entities.summary: Seeing behind the ship may make fights easier than the original's.
entities.mitigation: Keep the rules and scanner, play-test, and only then decide on a retune, logged in the GDD and RULES.

entities.title: Aiming from behind the ship has parallax
entities.summary: Lasers may feel inaccurate from a third-person view.
entities.mitigation: A reticle on the mount's axis at range, and the in-line-of-fire mark from the sim's own hit test.

entities.title: Every ship is a Cheetah for now
entities.summary: Ship types are hard to tell apart.
entities.impact: Players confuse police, pirates and traders.
entities.mitigation: Per-type scale, tint and beacons; the alien ship and the non-ship objects are the first new models.

entities.title: godot-rust lags a Godot release
entities.summary: The engine cannot be upgraded when wanted.

entities.title: JavaScript and Rust maths differ in the last bit
entities.mitigation: Hash values rounded to 6 decimals; investigate at the first differing tick.

entities.title: glTF extras may not arrive as node metadata
